The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries.

It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times is looking for an operational owner and highly organized self-starter to join our Newsroom Operations team as an Operations Manager. You will provide hands-on support and oversight of numerous logistics involved in the smooth daily operation of several assigned department(s) – News Platforms and Data, T Magazine and others.
We are looking for a quick learner and creative problem solver who is capable of handling the ever-changing demands of a fast-paced newsroom environment. You will guide tasks across the finish line for the desks in the newsroom.

Key to this will be supporting members of our masthead and our journalists with a variety of daily responsibilities and short- and long-term projects.

This includes being at the center of on-the-ground coordination of both in-office and offsite events, ensuring execution of on-site logistics and meals for key news coverage events, ensuring that administrative operational tasks are completed by internal deadlines so that operations on the desk run continually and uninterrupted.

You will report directly to a Senior Manager of Newsroom Operations.
This role will be Hybrid, with a required in-office presence of 4 days a week. The schedule of these 4 days can fluctuate based on the needs of the desks, and during some peak news cycles, you may be required to be on site for 5 days during those weeks.

Serve as the primary, accountable operational contact for members of the masthead, department heads, and journalists, resolving operational roadblocks independently.
Responsible for on-site setup of various in-office events including mock elections, team all hands gatherings of staff from around the country, team lunches and various similar events, and also serving as a production coordinator for all such events. including live coverage setups, catering logistics, seating arrangements, and equipment deployment during breaking news cycles.
Oversee complex equipment setups for assigned desks, special coverage teams, and events, ensuring that all hardware, workstation, and specialized technical configurations in real-time to ensure journalists have fully functioning tools.
Work with the Newsroom Finance team to help create annual budgets and provide oversight of those budgets, including monthly closes, supplying additional financial reports.
Manage work and vacation schedules and maintain accurate time banks in Workday, and work with Payroll to verify time banks for transfers, departures, and annual payouts.
Manage a travel calendar and be sure anyone traveling on assignment is properly set up on the company's business travel accident insurance.
Approve expenses and travel costs in Workday.
Manage and process freelancers and vendors' payments, working with the Contracts Manager
Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable for assigned departments
Work with HR and recruiting teams to assist with position management transactions
Facilitate Workday management, including onboarding new employees and helping them to get the training, equipment, and information they need
Keep staffing lists, org charts, and various email distribution lists up to date with any staffing changes in the department
Purchase supplies and equipment, keep track of all departmental expenses, including capital spending and outside vendor spending
Work in Zip for independent contractor onboarding, sourcing events and purchasing
Be available for a variety of tasks that come up, often urgently, including troubleshooting, assisting writers and editors,with on-site and off-site needs, etc.
Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

5+ years of experience in an operational or administrative role
Ability to drive projects forward
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience dealing with detailed and confidential and private concerns
You can work and keep an optimistic attitude while maintaining a keen sense of urgency
Be accessible after hours or on weekends when circumstances require
Impeccable organizational and time management skills; ability to multitask, prioritize and work under deadline pressure
Ability to work with all levels of management and staff and manage the needs of a team of 100+ employees and leaders

Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent combination of training and experience
Able to research resources, troubleshoot, and solve problems
Workday experience

For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.
For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process.

We’re excited to learn more about you and your experience. To keep our hiring process as fair and authentic as possible, we ask that you submit your own work and not use GenAI tools to generate substantive content during the application and interview process.
If you’re an engineering candidate, we’ll let you know what specific GenAI tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.
The New York Times Company is committed to being the world’s best source of independent, reliable and quality journalism. To do so, we embrace a diverse workforce that has a broad range of backgrounds and experiences across our ranks, at all levels of the organization. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of an individual's sex, age, race, color, creed, national origin, alienage, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation or affectional preference, gender identity and expression, disability, genetic trait or predisposition, carrier status, citizenship, veteran or military status and other personal characteristics protected by law.

All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)’s Know Your Rights Poster is available here .
The New York Times Company will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. Individuals seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process should email reasonable.accommodations@nytimes.com. Emails sent for unrelated issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

Reporting to the District Manager of the Oilsands, the Operations Manager, Oilsands is responsible for overseeing the Lodge Management team to ensure efficiency and effectiveness and execute the strategic vision of the Senior Leadership Team. This is a majority field-based role, with approximately 80% of time spent in the field and 20% hybrid. The nature of field operations requires availability on some weekends to meet client and business requirements.

s.h: This role performs some or all of the following duties
s.t:
Lead a team of field-based Lodge Managers to ensure compliance with proper operation procedures and guidelines.
Strengthen Dexterra Partnerships’ operational processes to build highly efficient and effective operations.
Liaise with senior leadership and ensure the consistent implementation of both tactical and strategic initiatives to all field operation teams within your span of control.
Provide leadership of the field operations team ensuring effective performance management and continued development.
Lead the implementation of operational improvements in the areas of safety, quality, customer service, finance, and employee performance.
Communicate and share company standards and available resources that assist facility operations.
Identify gaps and opportunities and determine root causes in operating standards and overall guest satisfaction.
Establish clear business goals and financial targets with the Manager of each location.
Identify opportunities and best practices to improve profitability of locations.
Ensure compliance with employment standards, human rights, health and safety, and WHMIS within your span of control.
Accountable for key financial and performance measures including cost control, EBITDA, and customer ratings scores.
Assist in effectively and efficiently managing the development of the Hospitality Operations team to promote high quality customer service and satisfaction.
Other related duties are incidental to the work described herein.

A “safety above all else” attitude is required.
Proven leadership and people management skills with the ability to motivate and think outside the box.
Minimum of 8 years of operations management experience.
Post-secondary education in management or a business-related degree/diploma considered an asset.
Experience in multi-unit management, hospitality industry, and/or oil and gas industry is an asset.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to excel in a fast-paced, highly challenging, and change-oriented environment.
Willingness and ability to work in the field approximately 80% of the time, including some weekends as required by client and business needs.

The Operations Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day delivery of integrated facilities and workplace services at the site. This role provides leadership and direction to frontline teams, oversees service delivery and vendors, supports facility operations and maintenance.
The successful candidate will be a hands-on and collaborative leader with strong facilities, people-management, and customer-service skills. They will be responsible for ensuring services are delivered safely, efficiently, consistently, and in accordance with contractual requirements and client expectations.
We are currently seeking an experienced Operations Manager to join our team at 19 Allstate Parkway in Markham, Ontario .

Operations & Facilities Management
Oversee the day-to-day delivery of integrated facilities and workplace services.
Ensure facility operations and maintenance activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with established standards.
Conduct and oversee regular facility inspections and ensure deficiencies, faults, and maintenance issues are identified, reported, and resolved in a timely manner.
Monitor service performance and implement corrective actions where required.
Coordinate with internal teams, contractors, and service providers to ensure seamless facility operations.
Support preventative maintenance programs and follow up on outstanding maintenance requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, service quality, and the overall client experience.
Team Leadership & People Management
Lead, supervise, and support janitorial, reception/mail, and other workplace services teams.
Establish daily priorities, allocate resources, and ensure adequate staffing and service coverage.
Coach, mentor, and develop employees to achieve operational and service expectations.
Support employee onboarding, training, performance management, and ongoing development.
Ensure employees maintain required qualifications and receive appropriate training.
Promote a positive, respectful, and inclusive workplace culture.
Address employee concerns and operational issues promptly and escalate when appropriate.
Vendor & Site Access Management
Oversee qualified vendor verification and site access requirements.
Ensure contractors and vendors comply with site policies, safety requirements, and established procedures.
Coordinate vendor activities and monitor service quality and performance.
Maintain strong working relationships with vendors and service partners.
Address vendor performance concerns and implement corrective actions as required.
Janitorial, Reception & Mail Services
Oversee the delivery and quality of janitorial, reception, mail, and courier services.
Ensure teams consistently meet established service standards and client expectations.
Provide operational direction and support to frontline service teams.
Act as a backup for reception and mail services when required.
Monitor staffing, schedules, service levels, and overall team performance.
Special Cleaning & Indoor Plant Services
Oversee the delivery of special and periodic cleaning services.
Ensure specialized cleaning requirements are properly scheduled, coordinated, and completed.
Oversee indoor plant service delivery and ensure service standards are maintained.
Monitor vendor performance and address service deficiencies as required.
Workplace & Meeting Room Services
Oversee meeting room management and workplace support services.
Ensure meeting spaces are properly prepared and maintained for client meetings and events.
Coordinate office support service requests and ensure timely completion.
Work with the client to identify and address changing workplace service needs.
Client & Account Management Support
Work closely with the Account Manager to ensure contractual obligations and service standards are consistently met.
Serve as a key operational point of contact for the client and workplace stakeholders.
Respond promptly and professionally to client requests, concerns, and service issues.
Support client meetings, operational reviews, reporting, and service improvement initiatives.
Act as the Account Manager's backup when required.
Build and maintain strong client relationships through proactive communication and exceptional service delivery.
Health, Safety & Compliance
Ensure all operations are conducted in accordance with company, client, and legislative health and safety requirements.
Promote a strong safety culture across all teams and service areas.
Ensure employees and vendors follow established safety policies, procedures, and protocols.
Identify and address safety hazards and operational risks.
Support incident reporting, investigations, and corrective actions as required.
3–5+ years of progressive experience in facilities management, operations management, property management, hospitality, commercial services, or a related field.
Previous experience managing frontline teams and multiple service functions.
Strong leadership and people-management skills.
Experience managing vendors, contractors, and service providers.
Strong understanding of facility operations, maintenance, janitorial, reception, and workplace services.
Excellent customer service and relationship-management skills.
Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and other workplace management systems.
Knowledge of occupational health and safety requirements and best practices.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
Post-secondary education in Facilities Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related discipline is an asset.
